title: F16 — Push and deep links
tagline: a push carries only a destination; sitelog://<route>/<id> is parsed once and routed, even after a cold launch; the app works fully with push denied.
intro: Sprint S8 · 14h · skeleton guide — full code is added when this feature starts.
Code in this guide is a teaching example. Check current source and follow F00 localization rules before applying it.

blocks.html:
• Goal: a push carries only a destination; sitelog://<route>/<id> is parsed once and routed, even after a cold launch; the app works fully with push denied.
  • Demo — offline: xcrun simctl openurl booted sitelog://session/42 opens the session; push denied changes nothing else.
  • Demo — signed in: a verified upload sends a push; tapping it opens the session.

blocks.html:
Overview

  • Goal: what a push may carry and how the app tells the backend where to send it.
ShapeFields
Push payloadaps alert, deepLink (sitelog://session/<id>), hashed account id — no names, no coordinates
POST /devicestoken, environment (sandbox / production)
  • Check: a push for another account is ignored by the app.
